qa_audit.doable_note: Step 16 (banner) uses image_fill_area to "place the graded ~2400x2400 square master on a solid white 16:9 2560x1440 canvas, bracelet offset, with text-safe negative space." image_fill_area is solid-color fill of a selection WITHIN an existing image — explicitly "NOT a compositor" — and cannot enlarge/re-shape a square into a wider-than-source canvas with the subject offset and added white space. That is canvas extension = image_generative_expand (banned) or local compositing. The reverify note itself admits step 16 was an image_generative_expand outpaint "replaced by image_fill_area" — a mislabel, not a real fix. Its output spec (2560x1440, wider than the 2400 source) is unachievable with fill alone. All other 20 steps are valid, correctly-ordered headless connector actions.
